description: A C# game engine used the way raylib is: open a window, draw each frame with plain static calls, and draw Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
Motion blur blurs each mesh entity along its own movement where SetMotionBlur is given objects, from a velocity image its moving entities are drawn into as runs of instances.
ReadyToRun comes out of the package again, the owner having chosen the smaller package since a game's author compiles the engine ahead by publishing their game with ReadyToRun or native AOT.
AssimpModelReader.cs's materials, meshes and animations move into partial files of its name, the code unchanged, which empties N 1.3's list.
The last public types declared in files of other names move into files of their own, the code unchanged, which empties N 1.2's list.
The public types of BehaviorAttributes.cs, SceneFile.cs, PhysicsTypes.cs, PhysicsComponents.cs and Hierarchy.cs move into files of their names, the code unchanged, taking N 1.2's list from 83 to 35.
The package carries the engine compiled ahead, ReadyToRun, for each of its six systems beside its portable code, so a game run from its project does not compile the engine in its first frames.
A directory of scripts is watched once a process, shared by the apps that compile from it and let go with the last, and the leak test's series reach the test page whole.
A render texture takes the window's samples unless LoadRenderTextureEx is given one, and where no audio device opens, sound goes to SDL's dummy driver, which takes it at the rate it plays, as raylib's goes to miniaudio's null device.
An audio stream with no device takes two buffers and then asks for no more, so audio_spectrum_visualizer runs where there is none, and a failed capture's error says why.
The warnings the suite repeated are mended, the tests letting go what they load and reading Summit's level with its components, a missing audio device said once, and Linux validating under a layer that knows every extension, which found a leak and unread vertex inputs.
Music opens XM and MOD modules, played by a tracker player of the engine's own that follows raylib's, and audio_module_playing is written.
The test page's repeated lines are those logged as warnings or errors or with no level, so the engine's banner no longer fills them.
A test's compiled probe loads where it can be let go, so no later app runs its behaviors, and a system that throws is logged with the assembly it came from.
AGENTS.md's table of areas names the docs, games and templates folders, as N 1.5 asks, which empties its list.
Fonts draw their color emoji, read by the engine's TrueType reader from PNG bitmaps or from colored layers, and a font of bitmaps alone loads.
The build workflow measures every example against raylib's program and fails where a pair stands more than a point above the share its own device recorded, leaving out the pairs that move by the clock or the audio device.
The font types and the baking of font atlases move into files of their own, Engine3D.Fonts.cs under 800 lines, off N 1.2's and N 1.3's lists.
The console's tests read no clock, a session's times fixed values and its heartbeat long past read as unreachable, off N 3.3's list.
Particles can bounce off or end at the window's depth of the scene, and the particles example's sparks bounce off the ground.
Shutdown joins the threads an app's parts start, the asset workers run on the pool, and the headless leak test carries the heap and thread series a macOS failure is read by.
The image, texture, render texture and n-patch types and the texture filter and wrap move into files named for them, off N 1.2's list.
LoadTextureCubemap makes a cube texture a shader's SamplerCube samples, models honor rlDisableDepthMask, and models_skybox_rendering is written.
ParticleBlend moves into a file named for it, off N 1.2's list.
A particle emitter can blend a sheet's frames from one into the next over each particle's life, which a sheet of drawn frames leaves cut.
TODO.md's cost entries are measured again, the per-entity one naming two changes and their savings and the first-use stalls found to be the runtime compiling, which a native walk of Manor at 18 ms at worst does not have.
The audio stream, gamepad, gesture and touch types move into files named for them, off N 1.2's list.
LoadImageFromScreen reads the last frame presented, kept from its first call on, and core_screen_recording is written with a GIF writer of its own.
raylib's automation events are carried, recording each frame's input into its text format and playing it back, and core_automation_events is written.
The comparison page keeps the sieve's coordinate and the grid on the bloom example's floor as differences in how OpenGL and Vulkan round.
Sound, music and stream pans take raylib's range of -1 to 1, audio_raw_stream is a port of raylib's program, and the audio examples are measured against raylib's.
The sphere, hemisphere, cylinder, cone, torus and knot are par_shapes' meshes as raylib makes them, every corner matching raylib's, so a texture lies on them as on raylib's.
The shaders examples are measured, mesh instancing and postprocessing are raylib's own programs with the engine's kept under names of their own, the cube lays its texture as raylib's does, and normals under a scaled node keep to their surface.
Models with no light are drawn unlit as raylib's are, an OBJ that names no material is white and points are drawn as raylib draws them, three references redrawn for the unlit models, and the models examples are measured.
Text is measured with the spacing between its characters as raylib's is, the text examples are measured, and font sdf and input box are raylib's own programs now.
The textures examples are measured, image drawing and the bunnymark are raylib's own programs now, and the shim turns an orbiting camera by the frame's time.
Shapes drawn in 3D leave out their back faces as raylib's do until a program switches culling, so a cube around the camera is hollow from within.
Lines at one sample are drawn by OpenGL's diamond rule and untextured shapes break ties between rows as raylib's do, and the core examples are measured.
The random values come from raylib's own generator, seeded as the window opens, and each pair is measured at a fixed frame time and seed with no input.
Thick outlines meet without overlapping and take a negative width outside the edge, circles take raylib's 36 pieces, and the shapes are measured again from a fresh build.
A body Bepu has marked to sleep keeps the speed or impulse it is given, since every wake now clears its candidacy.
Each written example is measured against raylib's own program drawn to the same frame, and the 45 shapes examples are measured.
A game's own text box places the input method's window beside it with SetTextInputArea, as an ImGui field places it.
The README's status points at the comparison page for raylib's functions left out, the audio processors among those carried.
RENDERING.md's order of work names what is built and keeps the one step left.
The reply on the norm's lists, paid down for the files this session touched.
Eight more public types move into files of their own names, and the physics tests are split in three under 800 lines, moved with three British spellings mended.
Seven public types of the flat API move into files of their own names, out of the files of its functions, moved and not changed.
The model renderer is split into its culling, shadows, pipelines and lighting beside its file, moved and not changed.
Two probe tests stop sleeping between frames for a worker the GPU filter replaced, and leave N 3.3's list.
The offscreen render tests are split by what they draw into six files under 800 lines, moved and not changed.
The comparison with raylib is checked against coverage.py's list of functions not carried, in the build workflow beside the table of examples.
Shadowed lights past the slots there are room for are ranked by the light that reaches the eye, so a bright lamp takes its shadow before a dim candle.
A reflection probe's capture draws the frame's particles after its meshes, so a fire in a room glows in its metal.
The cleft sentences and wanting things STYLE.md's checks found are plain statements, and a nullable warning the last test brought is mended.
A shader's texture and sampler declared apart, as HLSL writes them, are laid out and bound as such in every pass.
A reflection probe can be captured again every so many seconds, so its room's changes are seen, while it stays ready for its placement.
Four of raylib's functions a game calls are carried, and each of the 113 left is answered on the comparison page with its C# or its reason.
A script compiled again while its game runs is swapped in between frames and carries its components and resources onto its new types.
The environment map is filtered on the GPU by the reflection probe's stages, from a cube that weighs each direction by its solid angle.
A scene spawn that loads textures always hands back the loads it took, so no spawn holds textures past its entities.
C# typed with e3d eval is compiled against the running program and run between frames, a last bare expression answering with its value.
A reflection probe's capture is filtered on the GPU in the frame that draws its last face, with nothing read back.
Marks the library AOT compatible and clears what the trimmer cannot follow, the asset server's and the ECS's reflection mended and the console's and the script compiler's said at their places with why.
Draws a render texture into up to four images of their own formats at once, as a G-buffer is, carries rlgl's color blend switch, and ports shaders_deferred_rendering.
Reads Model 3D files as raylib does through m3d.h, a mesh for each run of faces of one material with raylib's last bone and its actions posed every 17 milliseconds, and ports models_loading_m3d.
Reads Inter-Quake Models as raylib does, an IQM's skeleton into LoadModel and its clips at the file's own frames into LoadModelAnimations, has IsModelAnimationValid compare counts and parents with names where a clip has them, and ports models_loading_iqm.
Holds the app a flow made last by a weak reference, since a context captured while it lived, as macOS's FileSystemWatcher keeps the one the script compiler's watchers start in, kept the whole app.
Carries UpdateMeshBuffer by raylib's index for a mesh's arrays, giving a mesh colors and second texture coordinates it lacks, and ports shaders_lightmap_rendering.
Gives a mesh a color and a second texture coordinate at each vertex in buffers of their own, read through a second vertex stage only for a mesh that has them, reads MagicaVoxel's files as raylib does, and ports models_loading_vox.
Carries the monitor's size as raylib's SDL3 backend reckons it, PollInputEvents and SwapScreenBuffer for raylib's custom frame control, reads GetTime from the clock as raylib does, and ports core_monitor_detector and core_custom_frame_control.
Carries raylib's audio processors, the mixed ones on SDL3's postmix callback on the audio thread and a stream's or a piece of music's as it queues its samples, and ports audio_mixed_processor and audio_stream_effects.
Carries raylib's PixelFormat with LoadImageRaw, which reads a format into an image's four bytes a pixel, and ImageFormat, which keeps what a format keeps, and ports textures_raw_data and textures_image_processing.
Carries rlgl's depth test and mask as draw-list states, its matrix modes with a projection of a program's own, and a shader's written depth, and ports shaders_depth_writing, shaders_hybrid_rendering and textures_portal_window.
Reads BMFont's .fnt files in LoadFont, its pages stacked into one atlas and a gray page drawn white as raylib does, and ports text_font_loading and text_unicode_emojis.
Carries rlgl's custom blend factors and modes into the immediate pass, discards clear texels in 3D alone as raylib blends them in 2D, and ports shapes_top_down_lights and textures_magnifying_glass.
Carries raylib's high density, transparent, unfocused, always-run and borderless window flags, tells fullscreen from borderless as raylib does, keeps a hidden run's window hidden, and ports core_highdpi_demo, core_highdpi_testbed and core_window_flags.
Carries rlgl's culling and point mode as states of the draw list and the model pass, winds every shape, texture and text as raylib's rshapes.c does so culling keeps them, and ports shapes_rlgl_triangle, models_point_rendering and shaders_cel_shading.
raylib's three text examples that read glyphs by index are written with GetGlyphInfo by code point, and a font's tab draws as raylib's does.
rlgl's vertices given one at a time and its matrix stack are carried as raylib's examples call them, and seven of those examples are written.
The last of raylib's models examples that can be written are, an OBJ's dissolve and a clip's frame count are raylib's, and the timing example's keyframe marks show over its bar.
The rest of raylib's shaders examples and its spectrum visualizer are written, GenImagePerlinNoise, DrawSphereWires and the far plane are raylib's, pixels written into a render texture keep their place among its drawing, and ImGui is given the mouse buttons in its own order.
Ten more of raylib's shaders examples are written, GetShaderLocation finds array elements and struct fields by GLSL's names, and models_mesh_generation is raylib's.
Nine of raylib's shaders examples are written with their GLSL in Slang, and the torus and knot take raylib's numbers and planes.
Six of raylib's audio examples are written from its source, their sounds fetched from raylib's examples.
Five more of raylib's models examples are written, and a bone named as a mesh, a joint that weighs nothing and a frame between two answer as raylib's do.
Twelve of raylib's models examples are written, shapes_basic_3d takes raylib's name, and the cubicmap, single-sided materials and the sphere's winding answer as raylib's do.
The 25 of raylib's textures examples the flat API can carry are written, and a texture loaded since the last frame reads back at once as raylib's does.
Nine of raylib's text examples are written, and a missing glyph, repeated code points and texture filters answer as raylib's do.
The last eight of raylib's examples that use raygui are written with ImGui in its place, and default text below ten pixels and the frame rate's color answer as raylib's do.
Seven of raylib's shapes examples that use raygui are written with ImGui's controls where raygui's stand, in ImGui's light style.
Eleven more of raylib's shapes examples are written again, among them the clock of clocks, the ball physics and the Penrose tiling.
The flat API carries the 39 functions of raymath that System.Numerics has no counterpart for under raymath's names, and the comparison with raylib names C#'s own for the rest.
Nine more of raylib's shapes examples are written again, with raylib's easing functions and two of its raymath functions beside them for the examples that call them.
A render texture that nothing clears in a frame keeps what it held, as raylib's does, so a trail drawn into it a stroke a frame builds up where only the last stroke was kept.
A cause on the run's page and in its annotation shows the first five lines of its message with a count of the rest, so a rule's check names the places it found.
A reflection probe is ready once both passes of its capture have finished, and again after a light's change asks for it anew, where it was ready after one pass and never again once relit.
Nine of raylib's shapes examples are written again, shapes_basic_2d among them under raylib's name shapes_basic_shapes, and DrawCircleGradient takes its center as raylib's does now.
A script's generation unloads when it is compiled again, its thrown type counted by name and its registration kept out of the process's list, where it had registered the script into every later app.
The hook that fails a test for a logged error keeps the test's ears in its flow, so a test that awaits before it makes its app hears that app's errors and no other test does.
Each cause's annotation carries its whole entry of the page, and a notice carries the page's head and the lines repeated most, since a reader who is not signed in reads the annotations and nothing else.
The Windows job registers lavapipe where an elevated Vulkan loader reads it, a drawing test that needs a device fails with the probe's own error where none starts, and music refused for a file cut short lets the file go.
The window program that was not raylib's core_window_flags is core_window_toggles, and the table has raylib's window flags and high-DPI examples as missing the flags the flat API lacks.
A test during which the engine logs an error it does not expect fails with that error, laid to the test by the app that logged it, and a physics world disposed twice no longer throws.
A system that throws in every frame has its exception logged whole once and then counted, at each power of ten and in all as the app closes, instead of a trace every frame.
The frame profile of a headless app ends each frame instead of throwing for a device it does not have, which had logged an error in every frame of every headless run.
The tests run through build/test.py, which holds the suite to a time and a memory, runs it again in parts when a process is lost, and ends each run with a page of what failed by cause, which is the job's summary and annotations and is merged across the three systems.
core_input_gestures_testbed and core_input_virtual_controls are raylib's examples written again.
core_2d_camera_platformer and core_viewport_scaling are raylib's examples written again, and the comparison with raylib names the default filter and samples that differ from its.
Every method native code calls catches every exception, the Vulkan debug callback and the IME callback among them, and a test finds one that does not by how it is handed over.
A test reads the shell scripts the Windows and macOS jobs run, and those they call, for what only GNU's tools or bash 4 read, such as sed -i, and finds none.
The table of raylib's examples reads the ones that set OpenGL's state by what they show, so seven of them can be written, ten are missing with the state named, and one does not apply.
The flat API carries raylib's rcamera functions, UpdateCamera moves a camera as raylib's does, and core_3d_camera_first_person and core_3d_camera_fps are raylib's examples written again.
The script compiler reads the runtime's assemblies at its first compilation and once for the process, where every app read 60 MB of them at its start and held it until a full collection, which took the Linux test job to 16 GB.
The test of removals being forgotten reads the change tick before the removal, so tests running beside it no longer carry the tick past the removal and fail it.
The check of commit messages passes over the owner's setting of the version and reads a list for the owner's other commits, as N 7.2 now says.
